questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains to Dr. MIKOU the union electoral process. According to the labor code, how are union representatives elected?
options: By secret ballot within the profession
By appointment by the Ministry of Health
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union representatives are elected by secret ballot by the members.' MIKOU: 'So my vote counts?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, it's professional democracy!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU wonders about the structure of a union. Dr. YOUSSEF explains that there are different levels. According to the labor code, what are the union levels?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union has national, regional, departmental, and local structures.' MIKOU: 'So I can get involved close to home.' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks how a collective agreement is negotiated. Dr. YOUSSEF explains that the process is structured. What is the first step?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The first step is the official notification of the negotiation request.' MIKOU: 'So we don't go on strike right away?' YOUSSEF: 'No, we negotiate first, it's more civilized!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU wants to understand the role of union sections. According to the labor code, what are union sections for?
options: To represent members at the company or practice level
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union sections represent members at the local level.' MIKOU: 'So I can create a section in my practice?' YOUSSEF: 'If you have enough colleagues, yes!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains to Dr. MIKOU the concept of 'union delegate'. What is the main function of a union delegate?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union delegate represents employees before the employer.' MIKOU: 'So if I have a problem with my assistant, I see the delegate?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, they're the intermediary!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU worries: 'And if the employer refuses to negotiate?' Dr. YOUSSEF explains the remedies. According to the labor code, what can a union do in case of refusal to negotiate?
options: Refer to court or organize a strike
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'In case of refusal, the union can refer to court or organize a legal strike.' MIKOU: 'So we have weapons!' YOUSSEF: 'Legal weapons, yes!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF mentions the importance of professional elections. According to the labor code, how often do union representative elections take place?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union elections take place every 4 years.' MIKOU: 'Like presidential elections, but with less media coverage!' YOUSSEF: 'And with real stakes for our profession!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can one easily create a union?' Dr. YOUSSEF explains the procedure. According to the labor code, how many founders are needed to create a union?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'At least 10 founders are needed to create a union.' MIKOU: 'So with my 10 best dentist friends, we can create our own?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, but it takes work!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains to Dr. MIKOU the notion of 'representative union'. What makes a union representative?
options: The number of members and electoral results
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'A union is representative by the number of members and electoral results.' MIKOU: 'So you need members to be heard.' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, strength in numbers!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU wonders about union financing. According to the labor code, what are the sources of union funding?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Unions are funded by member contributions and subsidies.' MIKOU: 'So my contribution funds the union.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, and it's an investment in your protection!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains the right to strike. According to the labor code, what are the conditions for a legal strike?
options: Advance notice and compliance with legal procedures
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'A legal strike must comply with advance notice and legal procedures.' MIKOU: 'So we can't strike overnight.' YOUSSEF: 'No, it must be organized and notified.'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union help me with my taxes?' Dr. YOUSSEF clarifies the union's role. What is the answer?
options: No, the union doesn't deal with taxes
Yes, it can advise on professional taxation
Yes, it pays your taxes for you
No, that's exclusively the accountant's role
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union can advise you on professional taxation.' MIKOU: 'So I can save money?' YOUSSEF: 'Maybe, at least you'll be better informed!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF mentions union solidarity. According to him, what is the fundamental principle of union solidarity?
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union is about mutual aid and collective defense.' MIKOU: 'So if I have a problem, I'm not alone.' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, united we are stronger!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU wonders about union protection. According to the labor code, do union representatives benefit from special protection?
options: No, they are like everyone else
Yes, they benefit from protection against unfair dismissal
No, they can be dismissed without cause
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union representatives benefit from protection against unfair dismissal.' MIKOU: 'So they are more protected?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, so they can carry out their mission serenely.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains the union's role in continuing education. What is the union's position on training?
options: Training is a right and a necessity
Training is reserved for young people
Training is a waste of time
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Continuing education is a right and a necessity for dentists.' MIKOU: 'So the union advocates for more training.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, so we remain competent!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union help dentists in financial difficulty?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: No, the union does not provide financial help
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Solidarity funds exist to help dentists in difficulty.' MIKOU: 'So if I go bankrupt, the union helps me?' YOUSSEF: 'It can accompany you, yes.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF mentions the importance of union communication. According to him, why is it important to communicate about union actions?
options: To inform members and strengthen unity
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Communication informs members and strengthens union unity.' MIKOU: 'So I need to be informed of actions.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, so you can participate!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Are there conflicts between unions?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: Yes, they are in permanent war
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Strategic differences may exist between unions.' MIKOU: 'So they don't always agree?' YOUSSEF: 'No, but they often agree on the essentials.'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains the union's role in relations with institutions. Which institutions does the union primarily interact with?
options: The Ministry of Health, CNSS, ONMD
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union interacts with the ministry, CNSS, and ONMD.' MIKOU: 'So it's at the heart of decisions.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, to defend our interests!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU wonders about the future of dental unionism. Dr. YOUSSEF tells him that the future depends on:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The future of unionism depends on mobilization and collective engagement.' MIKOU: 'So I need to get involved!' YOUSSEF: 'Exactly, MIKOU, one by one!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains the principle of union action. According to him, union action must be:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Union action must be legal and constructive.' MIKOU: 'So no excesses?' YOUSSEF: 'No, we are professionals!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU asks: 'Can the union help with the training of dental assistants?' Dr. YOUSSEF replies:
options: No, the union only deals with dentists
Yes, it can contribute to their training
Only if the assistants are unionized
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'The union can contribute to the training of dental assistants.' MIKOU: 'So it cares about the whole team.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, because a good team means good practice!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF explains the notion of 'social dialogue'. What is social dialogue?
options: An exchange between unions and authorities
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Social dialogue is the exchange between unions and authorities.' MIKOU: 'So they discuss the profession's problems.' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, it's essential for progress!'

questions.question: Dr. MIKOU wants to understand how the union manages internal conflicts. Dr. YOUSSEF explains that conflict management is done through:
questions.explanation: YOUSSEF explains: 'Internal conflicts are resolved through arbitration and dialogue.' MIKOU: 'So we discuss before getting angry?' YOUSSEF: 'Yes, it's more constructive!'

questions.question: Dr. YOUSSEF, after explaining the workings of the union to Dr. MIKOU, asks him if he is ready to get involved. MIKOU replies:
options: I am ready to get involved and join
I will create my own union
questions.explanation: MIKOU concludes: 'I am ready to get involved and join!' YOUSSEF, moved: 'Finally! You'll see, MIKOU, the union changes a career!' MIKOU: 'I trust you, YOUSSEF!'
